newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Garuda Indonesia plans 25 pct float in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Garuda Indonesia plans 25 pct float in 1998.

text.p: National flag carrier Garuda Indonesia may float only 25 percent of its shares when it goes public in 1998, the official Antara news agency reported on Sunday.

The airline's financial director Subiyanto was quoted as saying Garuda was being given only two years and not the usual four or five years to prepare itself for listing. The report did not explain why this was the case.
It quoted Subiyanto as saying the airline's debt service ratio currently stood at 55 to 45 but gave no further details.

The report said Garuda planned to raise the wages of its cockpit and cabin crew following a recommendation from the Finance Ministry and the airline was currently studying the remuneration system of other airlines.
Garuda has recently faced a drain of experienced pilots to other airlines in the region because of its relatively low wages and inflexible payment systems.
